data.title: 泽塔 · 湖畔的情报藏筒
data.description: 盛夏的山间湖畔，泽塔穿着豹纹泳装蹲在浅水中。她趁四下无人，将装着情报的防水密筒藏进岸边石缝，水面泛起细小的涟漪。
data.location: mountain lake shore in midsummer with pine trees and a rocky bank
data.action: alone in shallow lake water, crouching by the rocky bank to hide a waterproof capsule
data.promptProse: Zeta crouches alone in the shallow water of a summer lake, hiding a small waterproof capsule between rocks at the pine-lined shore.
data.animaCaption: Zeta conceals the capsule among the shoreline rocks.
